text: The assigned first landing adds EWS to the shared Get Messages inbox scenarios and calls OnSyncComplete after the pagination loop, following each page token update. Its C++ callback emits FolderLoaded. This first landing was subsequently backed out for a Mac test failure and later relanded with changes; it is historical behavior, not the accepted callback implementation. Current completion has moved to a shared success wrapper and count-update/mOnStop consumer. No execution or later moved event-order resolution is claimed.
title: The initial EWS Get Messages test patch signals sync success after all pages
